DataShape.description: Datashape used in the UserExtensions ThingShape to hold GitBackup Extension user credentials per repository
DataShape.name: GIT.GitCredentials.DataShape

FieldDefinition.description: Must be the Git committer full name, eg: Joe Smith that is going to be set to the commit.
FieldDefinition.name: GitCommitterFullName

FieldDefinition.description: Must be the password (or personal access token) used for authentication to the remote Git repository
FieldDefinition.name: GitCommitterPassword

FieldDefinition.description: Must be the user used for authentication purposed with the remote Git repository
FieldDefinition.name: GitCommitterUser

FieldDefinition.description: reference to the Git Thing for which these credentials are valid
FieldDefinition.name: GitThing
